S024.name: Depressed_Mood
S024.description: A state where a sad, empty, or hopeless mood persists.

subtypes.Depressed Mood: A persistently sunken mood or feeling of depression.
subtypes.Tearfulness: A state of frequent crying or inability to hold back tears.
subtypes.Sadness: A state where a sad or gloomy mood is maintained continuously.
subtypes.Emptiness: A feeling of inner emptiness or a state of feeling no emotion.
subtypes.Emotional Numbness: A state where emotions feel dulled or paralyzed.

S025.name: Loss_of_Interest
S025.description: A state where interest or pleasure in previously enjoyed activities is markedly diminished.

subtypes.Loss of Interest: Reduced interest in previously enjoyed hobbies or leisure activities.
subtypes.Social Withdrawal: Reduced interest or effort in social interactions and maintaining relationships.
subtypes.Loss of Motivation: Lack of motivation to initiate or complete work or tasks.
subtypes.Anhedonia: Inability to experience positive emotions such as happiness, satisfaction, love, or pleasure.
subtypes.Indifference to Achievement: Insensitivity or indifference to personal achievements or success.

S026.name: Weight_Appetite_Change
S026.description: Significant increase or decrease in appetite or weight.

subtypes.Significant Weight Loss: Weight loss of more than 5% in a month without dieting.
subtypes.Weight Gain: Weight gain of more than 5% in a month.
subtypes.Decrease in Appetite: Decrease in appetite occurring nearly every day.
subtypes.Increase in Appetite: Increase in appetite occurring nearly every day.

S027.name: Sleep_Disturbance
S027.description: A state where there is a significant change in the quantity or quality of sleep.

subtypes.Initial Insomnia: Difficulty falling asleep and taking a long time to do so.
subtypes.Middle Insomnia: Waking up frequently during sleep or having difficulty falling back asleep.
subtypes.Early Morning Awakening: Waking up too early and being unable to fall back asleep.
subtypes.Hypersomnia: Sleeping for long periods at night or excessive sleep during the day.
subtypes.Nightmare Disorder: Sleep disturbance caused by repeated and distressing dreams.
subtypes.Non-Restorative Sleep: Feeling unrefreshed despite having slept enough.

S028.name: Psychomotor_Changes
S028.description: Observable increase or decrease in psychomotor activity.

subtypes.Psychomotor Agitation: Purposeless repetitive behaviors such as inability to sit still, pacing, hand-wringing, or picking at skin.
subtypes.Psychomotor Retardation (Motor): Visible slowing of general body movements, such as walking speed or picking up objects.
subtypes.Psychomotor Retardation (Speech): Long response latency or slowed speech when asked a question.

S029.name: Fatigue
S029.description: Persistent fatigue that is not relieved by rest and a marked lack of energy.

subtypes.Chronic Fatigue: Fatigue that persists for a long period even after adequate rest.
subtypes.Physical Fatigue: A state of physical exhaustion where the body feels heavy and easily tires even from minor activities.
subtypes.Mental Fatigue: A state where fatigue accumulates rapidly during the process of thinking or concentrating.
subtypes.Loss of Energy: Difficulty performing daily activities due to a decline in energy and vitality.

S030.name: Worthlessness_Guilt
S030.description: Feelings of worthlessness or excessive or inappropriate guilt (which may be delusional; not merely self-reproach or guilt about being sick).

subtypes.Feelings of Worthlessness: The feeling that one is useless and has no value.
subtypes.Ruminative Guilt: A thought pattern of obsessively replaying past minor mistakes or flaws and constantly reproaching oneself.
subtypes.Excessive or Inappropriate Guilt: Feeling excessive responsibility for trivial matters or daily events and believing one deserves punishment.
subtypes.Delusional Guilt: Guilt reaching a delusional level, disconnected from reality, involving feeling responsible for unrelated unfortunate events.

S031.name: Diminished_Thinking
S031.description: Diminished ability to think or concentrate, or indecisiveness.

subtypes.Reduced Concentration: Unable to pay attention or maintain focus on specific activities like conversation, reading, or watching TV.
subtypes.Indecisiveness: Extreme difficulty making even minor daily choices (e.g., menu, clothes) and hesitating to make decisions.
subtypes.Subjective Memory Complaints: Complaining of memory decline, such as forgetting where things were placed, due to reduced focus.
subtypes.Clouded Thinking: Thinking feels foggy, dazed, or not clear.

S033.name: Elevated_Irritable_Mood
S033.description: A distinct period of abnormally and persistently elevated, expansive, or irritable mood.

subtypes.Elevated Mood: A mood that is abnormally high, euphoric, and full of unmotivated happiness and vitality.
subtypes.Irritable Mood: A state where one gets angry or aggressive even at minor stimuli.
subtypes.Mood Lability: Rapid shifts in mood, alternating unpredictably between euphoria and irritability.

S034.name: Increased_Activity
S034.description: Abnormally and persistently increased goal-directed activity or energy.

subtypes.Increased Energy: Overflowing physical and mental energy, leading to an inability to stay still and a desire to keep moving.
subtypes.Hyperactivity: Doing far more work than usual or starting multiple activities simultaneously.
subtypes.Psychomotor Agitation: Inability to tolerate resting or stopping, driven by a constant need to do something.

S035.name: Inflated_Self_Esteem
S035.description: Inflated self-esteem or grandiosity (may range from uncritical self-confidence to delusional proportions).

subtypes.Inflated Self-Confidence: Feeling capable of anything and believing that failure is impossible, unlike one's usual self.
subtypes.Overestimation of Abilities: Unrealistically assessing one's talents, knowledge, or abilities as superior.
subtypes.Grandiose Delusions: The false belief that one is a special and important person with a special mission or purpose.

S036.name: Decreased_Sleep
S036.description: Decreased need for sleep (e.g., feels rested after only 3 hours of sleep).

subtypes.Reduced Sleep Duration: Sleeping significantly less than usual but feeling refreshed rather than tired.
subtypes.Loss of Sleep Need: Not feeling the urge to sleep or the thought that sleep is necessary.
subtypes.Indifference to Insomnia: Feeling no problem and continuing activities despite staying up for several nights.

S037.name: Pressured_Speech
S037.description: More talkative than usual or pressure to keep talking.

subtypes.Talkativeness: Speaking far more than usual and continuing to talk without rest.
subtypes.Rapid Speech: Speech speed is so fast that it is difficult for others to understand or interrupt.
subtypes.Pressured Speech: Cannot stop talking or tolerate silence due to an internal pressure to keep speaking.

S038.name: Racing_Thoughts
S038.description: Flight of ideas or subjective experience that thoughts are racing.

subtypes.Racing Thoughts: Thoughts spinning too fast in the head, constantly jumping from one idea to another.
subtypes.Flooding of Thoughts: Too many thoughts emerging simultaneously, making them disorganized.
subtypes.Inability to Control Thoughts: Unable to stop or slow down thoughts and unable to calm the mind.

S040.name: Increased_Goal_Activity
S040.description: Increase in goal-directed activity (at work, school, socially, or sexually) or purposeless psychomotor agitation.

subtypes.Occupational Hyperactivity: Driving significantly more projects or work than usual in the workplace or academic setting.
subtypes.Social Hyperactivity: Becoming much more sociable and extroverted than usual, actively meeting and contacting people.
subtypes.Hypersexuality: Significantly increased interest in or activity regarding sex.
subtypes.Psychomotor Agitation: Purposeless non-goal-directed activity, such as pacing or hand-wringing, driven by an inability to sit still.

info.persona: Nelly Arias blends a competitive, methodical mindset with a love for art and cultural traditions, balancing meticulous financial discipline with spontaneous salsa dancing and a habit of checking spreadsheets before bedtime.
info.professional_persona: Nelly Arias, a bookkeeping and auditing clerk with mastery of QuickBooks, Sage, and advanced Excel macros, leverages their methodical, detail‑oriented nature and bilingual fluency to streamline financial records for a diverse client base while ambitiously mapping a path toward CPA certification.
info.cultural_background: Nelly comes from a Hispanic/Latino background, with her parents having immigrated from Mexico and the Dominican Republic. She grew up in a bilingual household in Cincinnati, where Spanish was spoken daily alongside English. Family traditions such as celebrating Dia de los Muertos, quinceaneras, and cooking dishes like tamales, empanadas, and sancocho are central to her identity. She actively participates in the local Latino community, attending events at the Cincinnati Latino Cultural Center and supporting local businesses. While embracing American values of independence and self‑reliance, she maintains strong familial ties and a sense of collectivism that influences her collaborative spirit. Her bicultural experience informs her worldview, fostering an appreciation for both her heritage and the diverse cultural landscape of the city.
info.hobbies_and_interests: Nelly’s curiosity and love for the arts shape many of her leisure activities. She regularly visits Cincinnati’s art museums, such as the Cincinnati Art Museum and the Contemporary Arts Center, and enjoys exploring new exhibitions. She experiments with watercolor painting and attends community art workshops where she can practice unconventional techniques. Music and dance are also important; she takes weekly salsa classes and enjoys listening to a wide range of genres, from Latin pop to jazz. When she seeks alone time, she reads books on art history, personal development, and emerging financial technologies, and she writes in a reflective journal. She stays active by hiking in the nearby parks, practicing yoga, and cooking traditional Hispanic dishes for friends and family. Additionally, she volunteers at a local non‑profit that offers financial literacy training to immigrants.
info.sports_persona: Nelly Arias enjoys hiking the trails of Red River Gorge and practicing yoga at the Cincinnati Trail Club, follows the Cincinnati Reds, Bengals, and FC Cincinnati with fervor, and balances their competitive streak by setting personal bests in weekend runs while still cheering on their favorite teams.
info.arts_persona: Nelly Arias immerses themselves in the Cincinnati Art Museum and Contemporary Arts Center, draws inspiration from Frida Kahlo, Diego Rivera, and the contemporary watercolor works of Yuko Kobayashi, and finds solace in the salsa rhythms of Carlos Santana and the jazz improvisations of Miles Davis, which shape both their creative practice and reflective journaling.
info.travel_persona: Nelly Arias plans their trips with meticulous itineraries, having already explored the historic streets of Oaxaca and the vibrant art scene of Barcelona, while dreaming of a future retreat in the Dominican Republic’s Punta Cana to combine beach relaxation with a workshop on Latin American folk art.
info.culinary_persona: Nelly Arias, an adept home cook, loves preparing tamales with masa, pork, and ancho chilies, empanadas stuffed with beef, cheese, and cumin, and hearty sancocho featuring plantains, yucca, and chicken, often pairing these dishes with fresh avocado salsa and a side of arroz con gandules for family gatherings they host.

info.persona: Rafael Ramosrivera is a solitary, detail‑oriented handyman who balances a love for quiet routines with occasional bouts of forgetfulness, worries about financial security, and a steadfast devotion to solo evenings spent with graphic novels and the lively strains of mariachi music.
info.professional_persona: Rafael Ramosrivera is a reliable part‑time maintenance specialist in a modest office building; they use hands‑on skills from car care and home repairs, draw on bilingual fluency to translate for tenants, and follow a simple checklist to keep tasks predictable while allowing flexibility to avoid feeling overwhelmed by social demands.
info.cultural_background: Rafael was raised in a Mexican immigrant family in Chicago's Pilsen neighborhood, where Spanish is spoken at home and community festivals celebrate Mexican heritage. He participates in annual Día de los Muertos observances and enjoys the neighborhood's Latin American markets, where he buys fresh produce and artisanal ingredients. Though he has limited formal education, his cultural identity is a source of pride; he maintains strong ties with extended family in Mexico through regular phone calls and visits when possible. His bicultural experience shapes his worldview, blending Mexican traditions with the rhythms of urban Midwestern life.
info.hobbies_and_interests: In his free time, Rafael enjoys solitary pursuits that provide quiet comfort. He reads graphic novels and classic mystery books, often in the evenings at local libraries. He likes listening to traditional Mexican music, especially mariachi and ranchera, while cooking meals for himself. Walks along the lakefront or through neighborhood parks give him a sense of calm. He also tinkers with small model kits—airplanes and cars—allowing him to focus his attention on detailed, methodical work.
info.sports_persona: Rafael Ramosrivera enjoys solitary early‑morning jogs along the Chicago lakefront, practices light weight training at a neighborhood gym twice a week to counter lower‑back strain, follows the Chicago Cubs and Chicago Blackhawks from home on game days, and occasionally joins a community adult soccer pickup league during the summer for brief social interaction, though they usually prefer to stay on the sidelines.
info.arts_persona: Rafael Ramosrivera spends evenings at the local library immersed in graphic novels by Frank Miller and Alan Moore as well as classic mystery works by Agatha Christie, complements the reading with the lively sounds of mariachi bands like Mariachi Vargas de Tecalitlán and ranchera singers such as Vicente Fernández, and occasionally curates a small collection of vintage comic strips that they cherish as a personal artistic escape.
info.travel_persona: Rafael Ramosrivera prefers low‑key, budget‑friendly trips that balance short drives with occasional long‑distance flights; they have taken weekend getaways to Door County, Wisconsin and a cabin retreat in the Upper Peninsula of Michigan, enjoy exploring the historic streets and live music of New Orleans during a modestly priced flight, and dream of a future solo adventure to the coastal cliffs of San Sebastián, Spain, all while carefully budgeting travel expenses around their part‑time income.
info.culinary_persona: Rafael Ramosrivera cooks for themselves most nights, deftly preparing dishes such as carnitas, chilaquiles, and sopa de tortilla in a modest kitchen, enhancing flavors with fresh cilantro, jalapeños, and oregano harvested from a balcony herb garden, and while their skill level sits between home‑cook and aspiring chef, they prefer quiet meals at home over noisy restaurants, though they occasionally treat themselves to a comforting bowl of pho from a nearby eatery.

info.persona: Marta blends a vibrant artistic curiosity with a relaxed, sometimes disorganized management style, a deep commitment to community generosity, and a heightened emotional sensitivity that fuels both their compassion and occasional anxiety.
info.professional_persona: A seasoned hospitality and retail operations leader, Marta uses her bilingual fluency, high emotional intelligence, and an artist’s curiosity to design inclusive workplace cultures, even as their relaxed attitude toward strict scheduling sometimes leads to last‑minute itinerary shuffles.
info.cultural_background: Marta’s cultural identity is deeply rooted in her Mexican‑American heritage. Born and raised in the Mission District of San Antonio, she grew up bilingual, celebrating Día de los Muertos, quinceañeras, and festive parades such as Fiesta San Antonio. Family gatherings, Catholic traditions, and the flavors of Tex‑Mex cuisine have shaped her values of community, hospitality, and generosity. Her background informs her managerial style – emphasizing respect, relational trust, and collective harmony. She actively participates in local Latino cultural organizations, mentors young Hispanic professionals, and incorporates traditional arts and storytelling into workplace initiatives to foster cultural pride.
info.hobbies_and_interests: Marta dedicates her free time to exploring San Antonio’s vibrant art scene and nurturing her creative outlets. She enjoys painting abstract watercolors, visiting galleries and the San Antonio Museum of Art, attending local theatre productions, and photographing the city’s historic missions. Her love for Mexican cuisine inspires her to experiment with traditional recipes, and she regularly volunteers at community centers teaching arts‑craft workshops. To manage her emotional reactivity, she practices yoga and mindfulness meditation, and she finds solace in solitary hikes along the Texas Hill Country as well as reading contemporary literature, especially magical‑realist novels.
info.sports_persona: Marta is a devoted fan of the San Antonio Spurs and follows San Antonio FC soccer, while personally staying active through weekend hikes with the Texas Hill Country Trail Club and weekly yoga sessions, preferring low‑impact exercise over regimented gym routines.
info.arts_persona: Marta immerses herself in the local art scene, regularly visiting the San Antonio Museum of Art to study works by Frida Kahlo and Diego Rivera, attending productions at Theatre Nola, and channeling that inspiration into abstract watercolor paintings and cityscape photography of the Alamo and nearby missions.
info.travel_persona: Marta’s travel style blends thoughtful planning with spontaneous weekend escapes, favoring visits to Texas Hill Country vineyards, cultural pilgrimages to Guanajuato, immersive art tours in Santa Fe, and occasional European art‑focused trips to Barcelona, all while balancing a modest budget and family commitments.
info.culinary_persona: Marta enjoys cooking at an intermediate level, often preparing enchiladas suizas, chiles rellenos, and cilantro‑lime grilled fish using fresh chipotle, queso fresco, and homemade salsa, and frequently shares these meals at community potlucks and family gatherings.
